notes.title: Large Update focused on Bugs, Glitches & Gameplay Issues
notes.notes:
Just Amazing, You guys who reached out to us via e-mail, or the Streamers who ended up on a potential issue - again, you help us improve Alan Sharp and make it better, more engaging and more fun to play! ːsteamhappyː

This would be a large update focused on bugs, glitches, game crashers and some quality of life we've managed to finish in the past couple of days. Check it out!

[Patch Notes]


 Sam seen standing in the end - fixed
 Grammatical errors in some items fixed
 Added some additional "clues" (helpers) to guide players while solving the Regan case in the mansion.
 A sound cue added in the Asylum
 Tweaking the door jumpscare camera control
 Reduced the sound of "Journal Updated" when starting the final level of Chapter 0.
 Fixed issues with the save system
 Pick up sound of the statue on the bar - volume lowered
 Fixed the overlap speech in the Asylum
 Invisible walls added in the Artifact scene where you were able to pass through a wall to the living room. Added extra invisible wall to prevent going to basement and confuse players
 Added lighting helpers to prevent players wandering aimlessly around the mansion
 Weapon un-hidden on the AI
 Removed the hovering weapon glitch in Sewers
 Fixed the standing black figure in the hidden cutscene
 Removed "trace of blood" which got stuck on the screen during cutscene
 A lot of optimization, removal of unecessary objects and deactivation of several empty drawers and cabinets which confused players and made them open every single one of them
 Journal Entry fixes
 Maze Puzzle issue fixed which, although rarely, caused the pin to go out of the maze.
 Added auto-wrap function on the Journal Entries
 Voice-recorder removed once you get back to Regan Manor.
 Phone ringing removed which caused some players to think it was a guide for further progression.
 Fixed doctor in Save System
 A bug which locked all doors during Continue game - fixed
 Game crasher on cabin puzzle with the letters fixed
 4 drawings counting issue in Alan's home fixed
 Locker & Locker System removed - although it was presented as an Easter Egg, we do not think it would be suitable mechanic for our game.
 Fixed the issue where you can double-click the gun in the memory lane and cause the cutscene all over again
 Fixed crouch places issue
 Fixed the navmesh space of the AI which prevented it to go through doors or narrow spaces.



For the Next Update in a few days, we'll be focusing on Quality of Life things and additional localization. 

If you stumble upon any bug or issue, feel free to reach us via Social Media of your desire (we're active on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram) or via the Contact Form on our website and we'll gladly add it to the list.

We would also love to mention a HUGE Surprise in the following days for You and Your Friends! 
Stay tuned! ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Huge Update - Bug Fixes & Glitches
notes.notes:
Before we start addressing this update, we would LOVE to thank all of you guys who played Alan Sharp! We carefully watched every stream/video we could come across, whether it's live or pre-recorded on Youtube or Twitch.

We analyzed every single moment, writing down things which felt hard, bothered you, potential bugs and issues, suggestions, audience & content creator feedback - everything we could come across to make Alan Sharp as best as possible for all detective, horror fans and lovers of deep, immersive stories.

The number of players who already got the game in these two days is... astonishing. And seeing streamers/players immersed in the story itself was a dream come true. Thank you!

Now, back to the UPDATE ːsteamhappyː
We noticed some concerning issues which prevented some players from continuing the game at particular points, so those became our first top priority for this next patch.

Here are the things that will not bother you anymore, peeps! A good bug is a dead bug *demonic grin:

1. The Doctor not working in the asylum level after you exit and click continue - save system issues fixed
2. The pump puzzle bugging
3. The pump spawning a double cinematic and game crashing
4. Huge inventory fix which previously deleted items randomly
5. Removed a widget in police station
6. Fixed the "gun" at "Empty level" to prevent spam and cause a glitch
7. Fixed several journal entries
8. Removed a floating lamp light in Regan Manor
9. Increased blocking volume at the library which caused players to get stuck when opening the drawer.
10. Removed a trigger box saying "Not available in this demo"
11. Rotation fix for Last Checkpoint after you get caught - caused players to get confused when Sam was looking in the dark.
12. Fixed a bug which caused players to light up item before a puzzle is solved.
13. Huge graphical optimization for smoother gameplay and higher FPS.

Note: A few more "visual" things will be fixed first things in the morning tomorrow, although they won't affect your gameplay and get you stuck.
With the morning update, we'll also change the version in the main menu, so do not get confused when you see version 1.0.5 still there with game's update.

Also, we received a lot of questions regarding future chapters. Soon, we'll post another announcement which thoroughly describes how future chapters will be released to clear out any misunderstanding and confusion you might have.

As always, we'll continue to watch your videos, analyze your feedback, take into consideration your opinions and ideas and we'll do our best to smash any hidden bugs coming down the road :))

notes.title: Alan Sharp Demo Update 0.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

Like we said before, we are carefully evaluating every feedback that has been given/sent to us. This is a second minor update which we managed to release in such short notice to improve the overall atmosphere of the game. Here are some of the changes we added to today's update:

- Retweaking/remodeling and texturing of a few models.
- Fix of physics models which had a strange, clip behavior.
- Collision fix on a few props.
- Tweak hint basement door.
- UI fix in a cutscene
- Overall lighting & ambiance tweak
- "Fog of war change" reduced quantity and distance from the camera.

Don't forget to watch us tonight at 07:30 PM CEST or 10:30 AM PST for a Developers play stream on our Steam Store page.

notes.title: Update: Your opinion matters
notes.notes:
Hey there guys! Thank you everyone for playing Alan Sharp! We're so glad
that so many people loved it. We carefully considered your feedback and suggestions and implemented an update as quickly as possible. With that being said, here is a quick update and what's changed:

- Additional ambient lights and a post-process added in the museum room to make it lighter than before.
- A post-process lighting effect added on every inspectable item. We've noticed you had trouble reading some of the notes around the house, so we've added a helping post-process which will automatically enlighten everything during inspection.
- Increased "bang" sound volume in private room, fixed an animation when opening the padlock, several tweaks made in the storage room.
- Fade out the volume of intense music during the stairs scene, additional hint added in the museum room and a sound notifier added near the end of the demo.
- Added 3 UI elements on the screen for journal, inventory & flashlight. We've noticed some players who did not read the hint "Press F for Flashlight" and did not know there was a flashlight in-game. The icons are at the bottom of the screen and will vanish the moment you use that particular action.
- Phone sound timer tweaked and optimized even more.
- New texture and geometry added for the child in the Intro Cinematic to fix particular normals and shadows.

Thank you all for your contribution! We'll continue to work on another update and will notify you when it is available. Like we said, your opinion matters!
